scope: Saved/temporary destination rules in the trusted manager, private IPC, encrypted general profile and production host grant. x86 KVM laboratory host with TCG session/gateway; provider remains synthetic. This commit does not route Bun/webfetch through the tools proxy.

contract.temporary: RAM until general lock; not one-shot or time-limited
contract.edits: trusted manager/controller only; no session open
contract.save: all currently selected rules, then clear the RAM override
contract.default: no policy: tools listener off; explicit empty policy: all destinations blocked
contract.ask: blocked; no interactive approval queue yet

limits: The new compiled Bun/webfetch/shell probe is prepared in 7a6275a and is not covered by this report.
The scoped host probe checks denial and private activation, not a permitted request from the compiled client or differing A/B allowed results.
Per-request approvals, expiry, individual-permission revocation and Tor tools circuit isolation are not verified.
A previous console reopening failure did not recur in this 33-check suite; its cause remains undiagnosed.
Hardware isolation, physical USB boot, remote provider behavior and power loss remain release gates.
